jobs.description:
About Capgemini
Capgemini is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services. The Group is at the forefront of innovation to address the entire breadth of clients’ opportunities in the evolving world of cloud, digital and platforms. Building on its strong 50-year+ heritage and deep industry-specific expertise, Capgemini enables organizations to realize their business ambitions through an array of services from strategy to operations. Capgemini is driven by the conviction that the business value of technology comes from and through people. Today, it is a multicultural company of 300,000 team members in almost 50 countries.
 

Key tasks & activities
As an experienced SAP PS/PPM (Project Systems/ Project & Portfolio Management) functional consultant, you will be responsible for translating the business challenges of our customers into IT requirements based on SAP’s latest technologies in the area of PS and/or PPM. As part of a team of consultants, you will guide your customer in implementing, testing and delivering the solution.

Knowledge & Experience

• Master’s degree
• A good knowledge of the SAP solution portfolio for PS and/or PPM
• +3 years of experience in SAP PS and/or PPM
• SAP trainings or certifications are an asset
• Team player with strong communication skills and with a collaborative spirit
• Able to coach, support, train and develop junior consultants
• Customer oriented, result driven & focused on delivering quality
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English
• Willing to work on assignments in Belgium and potentially abroad
• Belgian residency

About this vacancy
As an Experienced DataStage Developer, you play a key role in maintaining and evolving a critical legacy data platform while supporting the organization's transition towards a modern cloud-based data ecosystem. You ensure the stability, performance, and continuity of existing DataStage solutions while contributing to migration initiatives towards Microsoft Azure and modern data platforms.
Your responsibilities include:
• Maintaining, supporting, and enhancing existing IBM DataStage ETL workflows and data integration processes.
• Performing impact analyses and implementing small to medium-sized changes to the legacy data platform.
• Troubleshooting production issues and ensuring the reliability of data pipelines.
• Collaborating with business users, analysts, and technical teams to deliver ongoing improvements.
• Supporting the migration of data workloads from on-premises environments to Azure-based data platforms.
• Assisting in the redesign and modernization of data integration processes and architectures.
• Ensuring data quality, security, governance, and compliance standards are upheld.
• Documenting existing solutions, enhancements, and migration activities.
• Contributing to knowledge transfer and helping bridge the gap between legacy and cloud technologies.
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a DataStage Developer, ETL Developer, or in a similar data integration role.
• Strong hands-on experience with IBM DataStage development, maintenance, and support.
• Solid knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, data mapping, and data quality principles.
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
• Experience maintaining and enhancing legacy data platforms in enterprise environments.
• Exposure to cloud technologies and data modernization initiatives.
• Experience with Microsoft Azure data services is considered a strong plus.
• Familiarity with modern data engineering concepts, data lakes, and cloud-based architectures is an advantage.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
• Professional proficiency in French and English is mandatory.

The first task concerns the management (within SMA) of the public consultation. In November 2024, the client will submit the scenario (assumptions in terms of electricity demand, thermal generation, etc.) and methodology (how is the study performed) to public consultation and many reactions from stakeholders are expected (last study more than 200 comments were sent by stakeholders). Help will be needed to prepare documents with the reactions received so that the SMA expert can then give answers to the reactions. We expect the consultant to consolidate comments per topics, coordinate answers from the SMA experts and follow-up on the work to ensure right delivery. The consultation report (with the client’s answer to each reaction) should be ready by mid-February 2025. Note that no interaction is expected from the PMO with external stakeholders (this is managed by SMA experts)

The second task regards the management of the layouted report (within SMA and in collaboration with the layouting company). The final deliverable of the Adequacy and Flexibility study is indeed a large report (about 400 pages) to be published in June 2025.

 

Your profile

• Degree in management, economics or engineering, or relevant experience in the energy sector or in project management.
• Knowledge of Illustrator
• Good level of Dutch and/or French and English is required.
• Well organised
• Attention for details
• Autonomous and capable to manage and respect the project deadlines
• Pro-active

The Consulting Business Line at Sopra Steria is a team of over 160 consultants in Belgium with extensive expertise in Digital Transformation. Recognized as a preferred digital partner, we collaborate with leading Belgian organizations across the Public Sector, Financial Services, and Industry. Our consulting services span IT Advisory, Architecture, Organizational Transformation & Change, Operational Excellence, Sustainability & Ethics and Innovation as a Service.  

Your primary focus will be client engagements, which will constitute the majority of your time. These engagements may involve working as part of high-performing teams embedded within client organizations or contributing to Sopra Steria’s fixed-price Consulting projects within multidisciplinary teams. 

As a Consultant, you will contribute, as an integral member of the project team, to consulting assignments, you work closely with the client to listen and analyse their needs, you contribute to sales processes (spotting opportunities and drafting offers), and contributes to knowledge sharing within the organisation. On specific projects, your responsibilities may include business and functional analysis, project management, architectural design and Agile/Scrum facilitation. 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:   

Education: you recently completed (or will soon complete) your Master education. Any Master where IT/Business/Economics/Management topics were positioned centrally are relevant. 

Experience: a first experience in Business/IT Consulting or any other relevant domain is a strong plus. No experience yet, but freshly graduated and highly motivated? We will definitely consider that as well! 

Business & IT: strong affinity and interest in digitalization, IT and technology, combined with a strong business acumen to build bridges between business and IT. 

Areas of Expertise: any skills obtained in one or more of the following domains is a plus: IT Advisory (Target Operating Models), Project Management, Business/Functional Analysis, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Architectural Design, ESG, or Product Management. 

Consulting Mindset: strong ability to build and maintain trustworthy client relationships, familiarity with business development approaches, and a strong connection to the Consulting "motherhouse." 

Languages: you are fluent in Dutch or French, have a good understanding of the other language, and are also fluent in English.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

jobs.occupation: AP Manager | International Finance | Medical Sector
jobs.description:
Permanent | From €6,000 gross/month | Leuven

Thirty countries. Sixty legal entities. A BPO partner in India. Monthly closes under pressure and an ERP migration running straight through live operations. You've been there, and you know exactly how to bring structure, calm and quality to an environment that never stops moving.

 

We're looking for an AP Manager to lead the European AP hub of an international market leader in medical products, based in Leuven. This is a Global Business Services environment with teams spanning Belgium, the UK and India, an active finance transformation programme and products that make a genuine difference in healthcare every single day.

 

 

 

 

 

The Role

As AP Manager, you hold full ownership of the Accounts Payable function and serve as the key link between finance and international business stakeholders. From the European hub in Leuven, you oversee AP operations across Belgium, the United Kingdom and India, working closely with teams distributed around the world.

 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Full AP cycle for European countries: receipt, review, processing and approval of invoices in line with group policy
• Three-way matching, discrepancy follow-up and escalation where required
• Preparation and execution of payment runs across multiple methods (EFT, Wire, ACH, DD, SEPA B2B/B2C)
• Vendor reconciliations, AP subledger alignment with the GL and management of intercompany balances
• Monthly and year-end close activities: accruals, prepayments, open POs and AP adjustments
• Compliance oversight: VAT, Intrastat, SOX requirements, internal controls and segregation of duties
• Building and monitoring KPIs and AP reporting: ageing, vendor spend, payment forecasts and accrual summaries
• Supporting audit processes: providing documentation, explaining reconciliations and implementing recommendations
 

People Management & Leadership

• Managing, coaching and developing international AP teams and BPO partners
• Monitoring SLA quality and operational consistency across outsourced processes
• Providing technical guidance on the ERP system to BPO teams, acting as the go-to for complex processing and system queries
• Visible, engaged leadership: present for your people across time zones and national borders

Your Profile

You're a senior finance professional who knows complex AP environments inside out. You keep your team in sight and know how to introduce structure and composure into an organisation that's constantly evolving.

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a financial discipline
• A minimum of 10 years' relevant experience in AP and GL, ideally across multiple countries and legal entities
• Proven leadership experience, both direct and through BPO coordination and process ownership
• Hands-on knowledge of major ERP systems such as Oracle Cloud Financials or SAP S/4HANA
• Familiar with US GAAP and/or IFRS and financial close across multiple entities
• Strong knowledge of VAT in an international context, SOX and internal controls
• Demonstrable experience with finance transformation or ERP implementation projects is a significant advantage
• Analytical, solutions-focused and comfortable in a high-complexity, fast-changing environment
• Fluent in English (essential); French or Dutch is an advantage
• Willing to travel internationally: regular trips to the UK, occasional travel to Asia

About this vacancy
As a Business & Process Analyst, you play a pivotal role in bridging business needs, operational processes, and technology solutions. You work closely with stakeholders across the organization to analyze business requirements, optimize processes, and translate needs into clear, actionable deliverables.

This role combines traditional business analysis with process improvement responsibilities. We are looking for someone who is not only an excellent communicator but also highly analytical, comfortable working with complex data, and capable of approaching challenges with a strong quantitative and logical mindset.
Your responsibilities include:
• Gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements from various stakeholders.
• Translating business needs into clear functional specifications and Product Backlog Items (PBIs).
• Writing, maintaining, and refining PBIs to support development and delivery teams.
• Mapping, analyzing, and optimizing end-to-end business processes.
• Identifying inefficiencies, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Facilitating workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and stakeholder interviews.
• Collaborating closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders.
• Supporting the implementation of new solutions and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
• Performing data analysis to support decision-making and validate process improvements.
• Defining and documenting business rules, process flows, and functional requirements.
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
• Supporting testing activities, acceptance criteria reviews, and solution validation
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, or in a combined business/process transformation role.
• Proven experience in both business analysis and process analysis within complex environments.
• Strong experience writing and managing Product Backlog Items (PBIs) and working within Agile delivery frameworks.
• Ability and willingness to actively contribute to backlog management and requirement definition activities.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured approach to decision-making.
• Excellent quantitative reasoning skills and the ability to work with data-driven insights.
• A strong affinity with mathematics, logic, process modeling, and analytical thinking.
• Ability to quickly understand complex business challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
• Experience with business process mapping methodologies and continuous improvement frameworks.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across both business and technical teams.
• Comfort working with data, KPIs, reporting, and performance measurements.
• Experience working alongside technical teams and understanding technical constraints and opportunities.
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Scrum, and modern delivery practices.
• Experience with BPMN is considerd a must. Language requirements
• Professional proficiency in French and English is mandatory.
• Strong written communication skills in both languages are required for documentation and stakeholder engagement.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects.

You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• Preferably you have a master's or bachelor’s degree in IT

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

Are you an experienced Data Engineer who thrives in the ever-changing world of Information Technology? Then we have exciting opportunities for you!

We are looking for multiple freelance professionals for different projects. Your personal passion, interests and experience will be decisive in setting the right accents and determining your personal journey.

Your job responsibilities:

• Have experience in one or more of the following: data modelling, data warehousing, databases, ETL/ELT. Experience in data warehouse automation is considered as a plus.
• Knowledge of advanced data analysis tools and programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Java. Strong knowledge of PowerBI & Databricks are a must.
• You can turn the organisation's data into impactful reporting and clear insights that provide interpretation and lead to business process improvements.
• Creating data mappings, implementing standards, clean up data and implementing reference datasets.
• Deep experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data, as well as a deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and the ability to translate this into business implications for our clients.
 

Your Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Business engineering, business management or equivalent experience (5+ years).
• Dutch or French speaking with a strong knowledge of English.
• You are located in Belgium & able to work on-site/remote depending on the client’s needs.
You will work at a variety of large enterprises depending on your interest and your preferred way of working. At Brainbridge we cover the IT landscape from A to Z.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Specialist L1 - Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive and customer-oriented IT Support Specialist to join our client's team in Brussels. You will play a key role in providing first- and second-line technical support to end users within a dynamic service-driven environment.

This position requires excellent English communication skills, a strong service mindset, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural setting.

• Provide first IT support to internal users (onsite and remote)
• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues
• Manage and track incidents and service requests using a ticketing system
• Install, configure, and maintain IT equipment (laptops, desktops, mobile devices)
• Support Microsoft environments (Windows, Office 365, Teams, etc.)
• Escalate complex issues to higher-level support teams when required
• Ensure timely resolution of incidents within SLAs
• Deliver a high level of customer service and user satisfaction
• Contribute to IT documentation and knowledge base

Profile

• Previous experience in IT support / Service Desk / Helpdesk - max 3 years of experience
• Strong knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft 365, and basic networking
• Excellent communication skills in English (mandatory) - both written and spoken
• Customer-focused attitude with strong interpersonal skills
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently
• Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks efficiently

In this role, you are responsible for managing, analyzing, and interpreting the entire range of TradeMarks products as well as several Private Labels in our Product Cataloguing systems. You will keep the product data and cataloguing data of our own brands and private label product data up-to-date and consistent in various databases (e.g., LIS, PIM, ADMIN, TecDoc, X-checker, etc.). Analyzing data across different systems to identify and correct discrepancies and inconsistencies. This work is primarily done using Excel.

 

Responsibilities:

• You assist in optimizing cataloguing processes and data flows. You ensure that data efficiently and accurately flows from our internal systems to various other systems such as websites, platforms, customer portals, etc.
• You support various data update processes and always do so within the agreed timelines.
• You ensure top-quality cataloguing product data, which adds value for our customers.
• You configure data into the formats desired by customers and the various digital formats used in automotive industry catalogues.
• You support both the Product and Marketing teams with analyses and overviews of the cataloguing product data.
• Additionally, you play a crucial role in developing and implementing data management processes and procedures to ensure data quality and accuracy.
• You work closely with the managers of the various databases and other colleagues on data and database optimization and maintenance. You take action where necessary.
• You serve as a backup for the product data specialists.
• 
Moreover, you will have the opportunity to grow in your role and take responsibility for (sub)projects within the Product Cataloguing processes

 

Job Requirements:

• You have at least a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• You have some experience in Data Management (1-5 years), preferably in the Automotive and/or Chemical sector.
• You possess excellent computer skills:
• Excel: advanced (knowledge of pivots, vlookups, concatenates, comparing different data files, etc.)
• Access DB: basic, i.e., loading tables (manually or via import), basic queries, etc.
• Knowledge of cataloguing data systems is an advantage: PIM, TecDoc, X-checker.
• You speak and write fluent Dutch and English. Any other language is a plus.
• You are interested in quality product information, have a keen eye for detail, and work very accurately. You are also eager to continuously expand your knowledge.
• You prefer a structured approach to task follow-up and are capable of working independently. At the same time, you are a team player who relies on and draws upon the expertise of colleagues to help you in your daily tasks.
• You possess good and detailed analytical skills. You are able to work with data from different sources that are not 100% identical and find ways to link this data from various sources.
• You can set priorities, enabling you to consistently achieve the set objectives and deadlines.
• 
Additionally, you are an innovative thinker, always looking for improvements and opportunities in the market. Your organizational skills allow you to effectively manage projects and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

Job description 

The Adventures of an International Driver
 Are you ready to take the wheel and turn every trip into an adventure? As an international driver, you’ll be transporting goods all across Europe—think the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France—behind the wheel of a sleek tarpaulin truck.

From candy to concrete, meat to zinc on pallets, no two loads are ever the same. It’s like a market of surprises—just with more driving and fewer small talk breaks!

Planning and timing are your superpowers. You’ll keep trips efficient, respect driving and rest rules, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination perfectly. Customers? Think of them as friends—you’ll want to impress every single one.

Flexibility and independence are key. Unexpected challenges? You handle them like a pro. One thing’s for sure: life as an international driver is never boring, always full of variety, and packed with adventure.

 Requirements 

Driving License CE + Code 95 Reliable, Flexible

I can communicate in Dutch, French, and English. That's convenient, right? No language barriers here, just a glass wall full of fun!

We're looking for an experienced Fullstack Analyst Developer with solid front-end expertise, particularly with React and .NET, to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be able to contribute to the design, development and maintenance of software applications used by our customers.

Working with an experienced team, he/she will actively participate in the continuous improvement of our processes and software architecture.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• Analysis and Design: Analyze functional and technical requirements and design appropriate software architectures.
